# emoy.app

Public pages for the EMOY app: landing, privacy policy, and account-deletion
instructions.

**Generated — do not edit the HTML here by hand.** The source of truth is
`docs/*.md` in the private app repo; `scripts/build_legal_site.py` renders it.
Editing a page here directly will be overwritten on the next build, and these
are legal documents, so a silent divergence matters.
